items: Standard operating procedures can carry a single fast food location, but speed and consistency get much harder to hold across every store as you scale into multiple locations or a franchise.
Pick software by the part of the operation it fixes: voice AI for drive-thru and phone orders, review replies, kitchen ticket sequencing, or inventory and food cost.
AI-driven inventory tools match ordering and prep to forecasted demand, so you stock based on what actually sells and catch kitchen bottlenecks before they slow service.
For guest experience, Momos' AI agent Alfie reads each review, considers the guest's visit history, and writes an on-brand, personalized reply within minutes.
